description: This file is a shell script containing tests for git's 'update-ref' error handling and reference management functionality. It includes test functions, setup routines, and multiple test cases that check different edge cases, conflict scenarios, and error conditions related to git references.

methods.name: test_update_rejected
methods.description: A function to test whether 'git update-ref' rejects the creation or update of references under certain conditions, validating the error message.

methods.name: df_test
methods.description: A function to test conflict scenarios involving deletion and addition of refs, including symbolic references, with various options like packing.
